questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It is the Governor of the State who recognizes and declares any community of that State as a Scheduled Tribe. 2️⃣ A community declared as a Scheduled Tribe in a State need not be so in another State.
questions.e: The President, not the Governor, has the final authority to notify STs. Statement 2 is correct as tribal status is state-specific.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam': 1️⃣ Provisions will come into effect from the 18th Lok Sabha. 2️⃣ This will be in force for 15 years after becoming an Act. 3️⃣ There are provisions for the reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes Women within the quota reserved for the Scheduled Castes.
questions.e: Implementation is linked to the first census/delimitation after the Act, so it won't be the 18th Lok Sabha. The 15-year sunset clause and the sub-quota for SC/ST women are correct.

questions.q: With reference to the Parliament of India, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Prorogation of a House by the President of India does not require the advice of the Council of Ministers. 2️⃣ Prorogation of a House is generally done after the House is adjourned sine die but there is no bar to the President of India prorogating the House which is in session. 3️⃣ Dissolution of the Lok Sabha is done by the President of India who, save in exceptional circumstances, does so on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
questions.e: The President always acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers for prorogation. The other procedural statements are correct.

questions.q: Which of the following statements are correct about the Constitution of India? 1️⃣ Powers of the Municipalities are given in Part IX A of the Constitution. 2️⃣ Emergency provisions are given in Part XVIII of the Constitution. 3️⃣ Provisions related to the amendment of the Constitution are given in Part XX of the Constitutions
questions.e: All these Parts correctly match their respective subjects as per the text of the Constitution.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about the Ethics Committee in the Lok Sabha are correct? 1️⃣ Initially it was an ad-hoc Committee. 2️⃣ Only a Member of the Lok Sabha can make a complaint relating to unethical conduct of a member of the Lok Sabha. 3️⃣ This Committee cannot take up any matter which is sub-judice.
questions.e: Non-members can also make complaints against members. The committee's origin as ad-hoc and its restriction on sub-judice matters are correct.

questions.q: With reference to Union Budget, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ The Union Finance Minister on behalf of the Prime Minister lays the Annual Financial Statement before both the Houses of Parliament. 2️⃣ At the Union level, no demand for a grant can be made except on the recommendation of the President of India.
questions.e: The Finance Minister presents the budget on behalf of the *President*, not the Prime Minister.

questions.q: Which one of the following statements is correct as per the Constitution of India?
o: Inter-State quarantine is a Union subject under the Union List.
Inter-State migration is a State subject under the State List.
Corporation tax is a State subject under the State List.
Inter-State trade and commerce is a State subject under the State List.
questions.e: Inter-state quarantine and corporation tax are Union subjects, while inter-state trade is also largely under the Union's domain.

questions.q: Which of the following statements are correct in respect of a Money Bill in the Parliament? 1️⃣ Article 109 mentions special procedure in respect of Money Bills. 2️⃣ A Money Bill shall not be introduced in the Council of States. 3️⃣ The Rajya Sabha can either approve the Bill or suggest changes but cannot reject it. 4️⃣ Amendments to a Money Bill suggested by the Rajya Sabha have to be accepted by the Lok Sabha.
questions.e: Lok Sabha is *not* required to accept Rajya Sabha's suggestions for a Money Bill; it has the final word.

questions.q: With reference to the Indian Parliament, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ A bill pending in the Lok Sabha lapses on its dissolution. 2️⃣ A bill passed by the Lok Sabha and pending in the Rajya Sabha lapses on the dissolution of the Lok Sabha. 3️⃣ A bill in regard to which the President of India notified his/her intention to summon the Houses to a joint sitting lapses on the dissolution of the Lok Sabha.
questions.e: If a joint sitting has already been notified, the bill does *not* lapse despite the Lok Sabha's dissolution.

questions.q: With reference to the Government of India Act, 1935, consider the following statements: 1️⃣ It provided for the establishment of an All India Federation based on the union of the British Indian Provinces and Princely States. 2️⃣ Defence and Foreign Affairs were kept under the control of the federal legislature.
questions.e: Under the 1935 Act, Defence and External Affairs were "reserved" subjects controlled solely by the Governor-General, not the legislature.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ On the dissolution of the House of the People, the Speaker shall not vacate his/her office until immediately before the first meeting of the House of the People after the dissolution. 2️⃣ According to the provisions of the Constitution of India, a Member of the House of the People on being elected as Speaker shall resign from his/her political party immediately. 3️⃣ The Speaker of the House of the People may be removed from his/her office by a resolution of the House of the People passed by a majority of all the then Members of the House provided that no resolution shall be moved unless at least fourteen days notice has been given of the intention to move the resolution.
questions.e: There is no mandatory constitutional requirement for the Speaker to resign from their party. The other two procedural rules are correct.

questions.q: With reference to India, consider the following: 1️⃣ The Inter-State Council 2️⃣ The National Security Council 3️⃣ Zonal Councils. How many of the above were established as per the provisions of the Constitution of India?
questions.e: Only the Inter-State Council is constitutional (Art 263). The NSC is an executive body, and Zonal Councils are statutory.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ If any question arises as to whether a Member of the House of the People has become subject to disqualification under the Tenth Schedule, the President's decision in accordance with the opinion of the Council of Union Ministers shall be final. 2️⃣ There is no mention of the word 'political party' in the Constitution of India.
questions.e: Tenth Schedule decisions are made by the Presiding Officer. The word 'political party' *is* now mentioned in the Constitution due to the 52nd Amendment.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: Statement I: In India, State Governments have no power for making rules for grant of concessions in respect of extraction of minor minerals even though such minerals are located in their territories. Statement II: In India, the Central Government has the power to notify minor minerals under the relevant law.
o: Statement I is not correct but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II explains Statement I
Statement I is correct but Statement II is not correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct but Statement II does not explain Statement I
questions.e: State Governments *do* have the power to make rules for minor minerals. The Center's power to notify them is correct.

questions.q: Consider the following pairs: 1️⃣ Separation of Judiciary from Executive: Directive Principles 2️⃣ Valuing rich heritage: Fundamental Duties 3️⃣ Prohibition of child labor below 14: Fundamental Rights. How many of the above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Article 50 (DPSP), Article 51A (FD), and Article 24 (FR) cover these three correctly.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: 1️⃣ Panchayats at the intermediate level exist in all States. 2️⃣ To be eligible to be a Member of a Panchayat at the intermediate level, a person should attain the age of thirty years. 3️⃣ The Chief Minister of a State constitutes a commission to review the financial position of Panchayats.
questions.e: States with a population under 20 lakh don't need intermediate Panchayats. The eligibility age is 21, and the *Governor* (not CM) constitutes the Finance Commission.

questions.q: Consider the following subjects: 1️⃣ Union List 2️⃣ Extent of executive power of a State 3️⃣ Conditions of Governor's office. For a constitutional amendment with respect to which of the above, ratification by half the States is required?
questions.e: Amendments affecting the Seventh Schedule (Union List) and the extent of state/union executive powers require state ratification.

questions.q: With reference to the Constitution of India, if an area in a State is declared as Scheduled Area under the Fifth Schedule, 1️⃣ the State Government loses its executive power in such areas and a local body assumes total administration. 2️⃣ the Union Government can take over the total administration of such areas under certain circumstances on the recommendations of the Governor.
questions.e: Neither statement accurately reflects the Fifth Schedule, which focuses on specific tribal protections and Governor's oversight rather than a total transfer of administration.

questions.q: Consider the following pairs: 1️⃣ Arunachal Pradesh: Capital after a fort, 2 National Parks 2️⃣ Nagaland: Came into existence via Amendment 3️⃣ Tripura: Part 'C' State, reorganized 1956. How many are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 2 and 3 are correct. Nagaland's formation was facilitated by the 13th Amendment, and Tripura followed the described trajectory.

questions.q: The Speaker of Lok Sabha is not the chairman of which of the following committees?
questions.e: The Speaker chairs the Business Advisory, Rules, and General Purposes committees, but the Estimates Committee elects its own chairman (usually from the ruling party).

questions.q: Which of the following is not a formally prescribed device available to the members of Parliament?
questions.e: 'Zero Hour' is an informal Indian innovation and is not mentioned in the official Rules of Procedure.

questions.q: Central Vigilance Commission was set up on the recommendation of:
questions.e: The CVC was established in 1964 following the recommendations of the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption.

questions.q: The institution of Lokayukta was created for the first time by the state of:
questions.e: Maharashtra was the first state to establish the Lokayukta in 1971, although Orissa had passed the law first.

questions.q: Which of the following statements are incorrect about the difference between the writ jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and high courts in India? 1️⃣ The SC can issue writs for any purpose, HC only for Fundamental Rights. 2️⃣ HC can issue Injunctions, SC cannot. 3️⃣ SC only in cases of appeal, HC only when approached directly. 4️⃣ HC can issue writs for any purpose, SC only for Fundamental Rights.
questions.e: The Supreme Court can *only* issue writs for Fundamental Rights (Art 32), while High Courts can issue them for "any other purpose" (Art 226). Statements 1, 2, and 3 are conceptually incorrect.

questions.q: The conditions of service of members of All-India Services are determined by:
questions.e: Article 312 empowers the Parliament to regulate the recruitment and conditions of service for All-India Services.

questions.q: The ultimate responsibility of taking due action on the comments of the CAG vests with:
questions.e: The CAG submits reports to the President, who lays them before Parliament. Parliament's Public Accounts Committee then examines them, and the legislature has the final say.

questions.q: The word 'Budget' is mentioned in which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India?
questions.e: The Constitution uses the term 'Annual Financial Statement' (Art 112); the word 'Budget' is never used.

questions.q: Which of the following expenditures are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India? 1️⃣ Allowances of the Chairman of Rajya Sabha 2️⃣ Debt service charges 3️⃣ Pensions of High Court judges 4️⃣ Arbitration awards 5️⃣ Admin expenses of CAG.
questions.e: All the listed items are 'charged' expenditures and are not subject to the vote of Parliament.

questions.q: Which of the following statements are true about the Governor of a state? 1️⃣ Executive power vested in him. 2️⃣ Must be 35 years old. 3️⃣ Holds office during pleasure of President. 4️⃣ Removal grounds are in Constitution.
questions.e: The Constitution does *not* specify any grounds for the removal of a Governor.

questions.q: Panchayati Raj form of rural local government was adopted first by (in the order):
questions.e: Rajasthan was the first to adopt it (Nagaur, 1959), followed by Andhra Pradesh later that year.

questions.q: A President's rule can be imposed in a state under the provisions of: 1️⃣ Article 356 2️⃣ Article 360 3️⃣ Article 352 4️⃣ Article 365
questions.e: Article 356 covers failure of constitutional machinery, and Article 365 covers failure to comply with Union directives.

questions.q: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment act provided for the appointment of the same person as Governor for two or more states?
questions.e: The 7th Constitutional Amendment Act (1956) made it possible for one person to serve multiple states as Governor.

questions.q: The term 'Cabinet' is mentioned in which of the following articles of the Constitution?
questions.e: The word 'Cabinet' was inserted into Article 352 by the 44th Amendment Act (1978); it is not used in Articles 74 or 75.
